max.conclusion: Reviewed MAX v0.66.0 to v0.72.0, release commit 538197e9e51dc307fd8579c00d45e9965213cd76, Core 0.406.0/Base 0.50.3. Portal copies (install prompts, agents, MCP, Zoom overview, command rules) moved to zm personal. Roadmap unchanged: broader meeting preparation remains planned and is not shipped.
